build_scope: Source/performance-review package, not a standalone complete repository build. Full validation imports earlier scripts/evidence intentionally omitted; the included profiling command uses the supplied physics sources with normal C++17/GLM dependencies.
diff_note: git diff --binary HEAD describes tracked changes; untracked files are included as archive members and identified in MANIFEST.json.
evidence_scope: Selected FTFT4A performance/profile, source-provenance and geometry/trajectory evidence; unrelated regression artifacts omitted.
execution: Export and integrity checks only. No builds, tests, profiling, optimization, commits, pushes or tags.
export_type: CURRENT WORKING TREE, including uncommitted and untracked source; NOT git archive HEAD
omissions: earlier FTFT validation dependencies and unrelated files
timing_scope: Baseline/final seven-run uninstrumented fixture timings are separate from diagnostic instrumented gprof results. Aggregate validation runtimes are not benchmark comparisons.
